reason: My lists and money notes already live in Notes and that works fine for me, plus I don't have income to spend $6 a month on another app. Maybe I'd poke at the free version once, but I'm not paying.
objection: If the AI misreads my receipt and I have to go fix every line, that's more work than just typing it into Notes myself.
would_change_my_mind: If a friend showed me it reading a messy receipt perfectly and it actually caught something I'd missed with my money, I might keep using the free tier, but paying would still need a student price around $2.
